name: Suitcase Deadlift with Isometric Hold
description: A single-sided deadlift holding a kettlebell or dumbbell at the side, with an added isometric hold at the top position. The lateral load creates anti-lateral-flexion demand throughout the spine. The hold at the top increases time under tension for the quadratus lumborum and lateral core.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Suitcase Deadlift with Isometric Hold in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Suitcase Deadlift with Isometric Hold.
steps: Step 1: Stand with kettlebell at side. Hinge at hips maintaining neutral spine.
Step 2: Grip kettlebell and stand upright without tilting toward the weight.
Step 3: Hold top position for 3-5 seconds actively resisting the lateral pull.
Step 4: Lower kettlebell back down with hinge pattern.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Spine stays vertical despite lateral load
